ios.desc:
Food you love, from the restaurants you actually know.

Toast Local is the app that lets you eat like a local — discover, reserve, order, and pay, all from the restaurants in your own neighborhood. Order pickup or delivery, book a table, and earn rewards at participating local restaurants nationwide, all in one app. 

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO EAT LOCAL
- Restaurant discovery: Browse real menus, hours, and photos for restaurants near you
- Reservations: Book a table in a few taps — no phone calls, no waiting on hold
- Pickup ordering: Skip the line and have your order ready when you walk in
- Delivery ordering: Get food delivered from your favorite local spots
- Rewards & loyalty: Earn points and unlock perks at participating restaurants you already love
- Order history: See what you ordered before and reorder in a few taps
- Save favorites: Keep your go-to spots and go-to dishes close for next time
- Deals & offers: Explore offers on pickup, delivery, and dine-in orders at participating restaurants

WHY EAT LOCAL WITH TOAST
. Every order placed through Toast Local goes to the restaurant you chose, so what you spend can support the local business you're ordering from.

KEY FEATURES
- Reservation booking with party size, date, and time selection
- Pickup and delivery ordering from a single app
- Easy checkout with saved payment methods
- Restaurant loyalty and rewards programs at participating locations
- Order tracking and order history
- Save favorite restaurants and dishes for faster reordering
- Search and filter by cuisine, location, and what's open now
- Ratings and reviews to help you decide where to eat
- Deals and offers at participating restaurants

FIND RESTAURANTS NEAR YOU
Toast Local connects you to local restaurants across the country — from your neighborhood coffee shop to the dinner spot you keep meaning to try. Whether you're looking for a quick takeout lunch, a sit-down reservation, or delivery straight to your door, Toast Local helps you find it and order it.

Download Toast Local today and start discovering, reserving, ordering, at the local restaurants around you.

quotes.text:
So what this POS company is doing that’s kind of interesting is they have a mobile app just like Uber Eats/Doordash but it seems to be direct through the restaurant: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/local-by-toast/id1362180579

Actually when I ordered through it I paid $45 instead of $60 via DoorDash/Uber Eats but the order was delivered by Uber.

The reason why I think this version will work is because it’s the same level of convenience in a centralized mobile app so single payment method, single portal to browse restaurants etc.

(I have no association with this company I just was looking into this last week on the train)
